top_signals.title: Emerging Markets Slide as Oil, AI Concerns Sap Risk Appetite
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market assets fell at the start of a key week for global markets, as elevated oil prices and concerns over the pace of artificial-intelligence development weighed on currencies and stocks ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest-rate hike — its first since 2023.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
